name: Brief mindfulness training and Stroop interference: data and code
description: Trial-level Stroop data (96 trials per participant) and participant-level data (group, age, sex, MAAS score) of 40 university students assigned to a brief mindfulness training or a control group. Raw PsychoPy files are in data/raw/psychopy.

affiliation.name: Department of General Psychology, University of Padova
Department of General Psychology, University of Padova

measurementTechnique: Colour-word Stroop task (PsychoPy); Mindful Attention Awareness Scale (MAAS)

variableMeasured.name: group
variableMeasured.description: Experimental group. Coding: control = no training; mindfulness = four weeks of brief mindfulness training.

variableMeasured.name: sex
variableMeasured.description: Sex. Coding: F = female; M = male.

variableMeasured.name: congruent
variableMeasured.description: Congruent trial (word names the ink colour). Coding: TRUE = congruent; FALSE = incongruent.

variableMeasured.name: rt_ms
variableMeasured.description: Reaction time from stimulus onset to response.
